name: Autopoiesis (meta-principle)
title: Autopoiesis — Meta-layer theoretical reference for self-producing systems
description: Curated meta-layer reference for the Autopoiesis meta-principle (Maturana & Varela 1972, 1980; Varela 1979; Varela, Thompson & Rosch 1991). Living systems are networks of processes that continually produce their own components and specify their own boundary — operationally closed yet thermodynamically open. The meta-layer reference covers Varela's six criteria, enactivist cognition, the modern Bich/Mossio/Di Paolo revival, links to FEP/Markov-blanket biology (Kirchhoff et al. 2018), and frames autopoiesis as the operational-closure complement to Homo Fluxus.
varela_six_criteria: boundary components produced by internal interactions
all components produced by internal interactions
all other operations subordinate to (1)-(5) — operational closure

contested_claims.statement: Mind is constituted by autopoietic embodiment
Society is a third-order autopoietic system
Artificial life can be autopoietic in principle
Autopoiesis grounds a non-reductive yet naturalistic theory of agency
